name: EPIC 212407984

text.card: A red giant 3,336 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.97 solar masses and 14.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,404 K at its surface.
